nota: Tiempos exactos: la pista es la concatenación de los audios de cada segmento con pausas fijas.

segmentos.texto: Hi! This party is great! I'm Sam.
Hi, Sam. I'm Aisha. Nice to meet you.
Nice to meet you, too. Are you from here, Aisha?
No, I'm not. I'm from Egypt. And you? Where are you from?
Oh, cool! Are you a student?
No, I'm not. I'm a teacher at the language school.
Really? I'm a student at the language school! Are you the new English teacher?
Then you're my teacher! See you on Monday!
